questions.q: What did Haggai urge the people to do?
questions.evidence: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house

questions.q: What were the people living in while Yahweh's house lay waste?
questions.evidence: Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste

questions.q: How will the latter glory of this house compare with the former?
questions.evidence: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies
